rules.feature: inline logic edit (already safe in this build)
Internal error isolation (no visible debug overlay)
Inferno suit: grant inferno_armor so it appears in items
Remove Fortune/Spin wheel (worlds + after battles) — gated by $DG.spin
Global speed: setPreferedAsTimeScale honors $DG.speed at FULL chosen speed (k==Tb lockstep) + drift-only $DG.applySpeed

menu_edits.note: Heartbeat calls $DG.applySpeed() (drift-only). NO animCap — sprite animation runs at the exact chosen speed (k==Tb), fixing Error #2007 (addChild null) in auto-grind caused by logic/animation desync.

After tapping the results screen, auto-grind waits __DG_commitMs (default 2500ms) before starting the next match, so each Firebase trophy write serializes/lands (keeps local AND server in sync). Tunable: window.__DG_commitMs.
